name: Piña de Esgueva (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Piña de Esgueva (a castle and a Maltese cross on red).
history: Municipal flag of Piña de Esgueva; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Piña de Esgueva arms — castle and Maltese cross on red
castle and crown of the arms
